title: The Box of Old Photographs
transcript: While clearing out a cupboard, I found a box of photographs that belonged to my aunt. Some showed relatives I recognised, but none had dates. I wanted to put the pictures in order, so I asked my father to look through them with me. He could often work out the year from a car in the background or a building that had been knocked down. We scanned the photos and added his comments. I ended up with a small record of our town as well as our family.

questions.prompt: What helped the father work out the year?
questions.explanation: 父亲通过背景里的汽车或已经拆掉的建筑来判断年份。

questions.prompt: What did the finished collection record besides family history?
questions.explanation: 结尾说照片也成了小镇历史的一份小记录。
